verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair question for a cloud platform, but the evidence shows no first-party way to run AWS through plain-language commands. The AWS CLI, with its autoprompt and completion, still takes structured commands. Bedrock and AgentCore are building blocks for developers to make their own agents. The open-source AWS MCP servers expose AWS to an outside AI client, and the natural-language part comes from that client, so it is adjacent support only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
